src/clipboard.rs.reason: Remaining branches require a live desktop clipboard and display server across supported operating systems.

src/main.rs.reason: The binary entrypoint is exercised primarily through PTY and end-to-end process tests; the keep-awake config plumbing added entrypoint-only lines and per-run coverage varies ~0.2pt with PTY test timing.

src/headless.rs.reason: Remaining branches require live ACP adapters and subprocess-driven headless sessions; package-wide instrumentation can vary with process timing.

src/pull_request.rs.reason: This boundary shells out to an authenticated GitHub CLI and needs a hermetic integration harness.

src/quota.rs.reason: Remaining branches depend on live provider-specific quota responses.

src/ragnarok.rs.reason: Full battle paths require multiple real ACP runtimes, git worktrees, timers, and GitHub or git subprocesses.

src/remote_host.rs.reason: This host adapter launches real ACP, subagent, review, side-session, and worktree runtimes; its behavior is covered through remote API tests while a hermetic multi-runtime harness remains future work.

src/self_update.rs.reason: Remaining branches require platform-specific executable replacement and downloaded release artifacts.

src/side.rs.reason: Side-session lifecycle branches require a multi-session ACP integration harness.

src/terminal_output.rs.reason: The remaining gap is split terminal byte-stream behavior at the PTY boundary.
